thread:
jonathan: quick sync — proposing a lightweight quota circuit that negotiates reduced guarantees instead of hard rejects during abuse spikes. aim: keep tail latency predictable while avoiding total outage. thoughts?

maya.h: can you sketch the failure modes? is this tenant-scoped or global?

jonathan: tenant-scoped primary. flow: probe -> soft-degrade -> negotiated-sla -> full-cutover. probe = a tiny sample of requests marked for telemetry.

kevin_c: i like tenant-scoped. curious about handshake: how does the platform tell a tenant their negotiated rate? token vs header?

jonathan: plan is header-based: response header Retry-Quota: 120r/min (example) and an emitted event so console/SDK can surface it. client can opt to backoff or accept degraded throughput.

anne_p: watch out for races when leases return mid-handshake. if quota suddenly frees, we need deterministic fast path to restore normal mode. otherwise we oscillate.

samir: telemetry requirements: need per-tenant probe success/failure, RTT distribution, and circuit invocation count. also correlate with abuse-score spike. otherwise SLO alerts will be noisy.

kevin_c: how about a two-tier token model: green tokens (guaranteed) + grey tokens (best-effort). When circuit active, we drain grey first and surface header. That avoids hard rejects for lots of bursty benign traffic.

maya.h: grey tokens sound good. tradeoff: billing semantics and accounting get trickier. ops will ask which tokens we bill at what rate.

jonathan: agreed. proposal: bill at normal rate, but add a flag in billing lines for grey usage. can be 0-cost initially for enterprise pilot.

samir: for safety, add cooldown hysteresis: circuit only decays after X minutes of healthy probes and a stable token refill rate. set X conservatively.

anne_p: do we need a centralized arbiter for negotiation, or can seats negotiate locally at the ingress proxy? centralized helps consistency, but adds latency.

jonathan: prefer a hybrid: local decision for fast path (approx), centralized for authoritative state and eventual reconciliation. local uses last known negotiated quota and probe hints.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: quota-circuit-probe v1 -> staging at 03:40 UTC.

kevin_c: test cases to add: 1) rapid abuse spike + tenant backoff 2) oscillation under flapping network 3) billing tag correctness 4) SDK visibility for Retry-Quota header

maya.h: also add chaos test where central arbiter is partitioned. ensure local fallback doesn't cause wrong overcommits.

jonathan: noted. I'll draft a short RFC with state machine and metrics. will include sequence diagrams and sample headers. thanks for the pointers. :thumbsup:
